title: galeopsis ladanum subsp. carpetana
intro: Galeopsis ladanum subsp. carpetana, commonly known as Carpathian galeopsis or Lad's love, is a plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae) characterized by its fragrant foliage and tall spikes of purple flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, and is often employed to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Galeopsis ladanum subsp. carpetana include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, expectorant, and antitussive, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
